title: Review generated-child-grant router jump under isolated contracts (no kappa)
body:
This independently reviews the new generated-child-grant/router interface in [thu-nmrc PR6719](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6719), exact head `3bad39ffd4faf7e8cb1bc5b47769cbb28511f797`, **shape/producer.py:linked_split only**. No interface gap was found under the isolated producer, counter, router and machine contracts. It is a written source-code composition proof, not execution or acceptance of the complete physical caller.

For every fixed L>=2, the review checks the total injective tape map, original-header exclusion, branch cases/defaults, goto targets, implicit write/move successors, all successful-halt replacements and unchanged rejection. The exact marked-head/erasure ABI joins the generated descriptors to the actual router. The one-bank input has length A*R=V/L; a bijective high/low decomposition proves exact addresses, rather than relying on matching volume. Conditional transition-count additivity uses the same instruction model and does not certify the source1000V/100V ledger.

Separate written review made two premises explicit: every role is a distinct physical tape and every reachable valid-success producer halt meets the exit ABI. Five written, unexecuted scope controls include a complete default-relocation counterexample that loops instead of rejecting, live-guide aliasing and a same-volume wrong high classifier. Earlier pre-freeze drafts are retained. No scientific source constructor, emitted-table generation/census, interpreter, checker or proof kernel ran. Original author-side walkers and arithmetic checks remain predecessor evidence and were not rerun.

The package retains six inert source copies with exact Git/SHA256 pins, the full argument and separate adversarial AI review. Committed byte/mode/pin equality and a manual archive/readback check provenance only. There is no registered scientific replay. Hosted CI: [original run41912345530](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41912345530) SUCCESS on this unchanged head:711 helper tests,24 platform skips. Scientific replay SKIPPED with an empty registered-package matrix. The synthetic checkout tree matches the published tree. No rerun; this is repository-control evidence only. This is separate AI review, not blind/human/kernel acceptance.

Outside: isolated arithmetic/counter/router correctness and numeric bills; physical staging/consumer/codec/GrantBridge/stack return, H-from-width/root headers, ancestor weights, arbitrary-depth production, routes/fallbacks, Gaussian children, precision/stock/tape/compiler/outer and all five selected assumptions. Owned copies get no productive credit; unknown costs are not zero. No paid saving, new kappa or frontier change.

Canonical main7c49fe32/eight bindings/revision8/selected6030 refreshed; the source advanced from the earlier a7a222 scout to actual grant production. Fresh complete open/targeted all-state/live-board overlap and limits are retained. The recursive-interface joint-query-controller card is explicitly changed to this narrower written audit; the full changed-demand/paid gate remains unmet. The separate6713 Fourier review request remains an unclaimed alternate, not a nonexistent handoff. Next work is an isolated-contract and emitted-table audit under a fresh budget.

Credit thu-nmrc6719; Ali Romman5829 geometry/allocator; David Arias2776 machine/assembler/counter; Mason Hale and retained codec/stack/return authors; Jose Manuel binary-control and JoyboyBrian binary-divisor lineage and retained contributors; classical typed simulation/mixed-radix tools. ToikY with substantial OpenAI Codex and separate AI roles, Apache-2.0. No merge or other-PR closure; maintainer edits and auto-merge disabled.
